patch.value: Add opt-in --atomic to linear import/sync via SDK commitItemMutations

Atomic, crash-resumable, multi-agent-safe bulk-write path for pm-linear. Mirrors the merged pm-github reference. Companion tracker: pm-cli-website-c9u0 at https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli-companion (parent epic pm-cli-website-s4wz).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
DESIGN DECISIONS:
- Stable item id keyed on Linear issue identifier (e.g. ENG-123), the most stable human-meaningful external key, never fetch order. deriveAtomicItemId hashes lowercased team + identifier through normalizeItemId.
- Transaction id fingerprints lowercased team + canonical entries sorted by the stable identifier + the exact ordered BulkItemMutation plan. A changed id_prefix or provenance match yields a fresh journal; a reordered retry resumes the same one.
- Mutation plan: create+update upsert for new/deterministic-id items (same plan on recovery when provenance scan finds the deterministic id); update(+close) for legacy matches at a different id. close is a separate mutation preserving a reason and is independently reversible.
- Compensation: createCompensation='delete' for creates; SDK version-restores updates+closes. On AggregateError/compensation-failed -> warn tracker MAY be partial + same-transaction recovery path; normal SDK compensation -> no new partial state; WorkspaceTransactionInterruptedError -> resumable.
- Byte-compatible default: non-atomic per-issue spawnSync path is UNCHANGED. --atomic --dry-run shares the atomic prep/matching path (fetches issues, reports create/update/skip counts) and NEVER commits; the non-atomic --dry-run stays fully offline (GraphQL request preview).
- All-skipped non-dry atomic import throws the SAME error shape as legacy (CommandError 'Imported 0 issue(s); N failed.', exitCode GENERIC_FAILURE) BEFORE commit.
- Exported CommandError/EXIT_CODE/LinearIssue/syncLinearIssues (+SyncRunDependencies test seams) mirroring pm-github; package.json peerDep >=2026.7.20, devDep ^2026.7.20 (latest published with commitItemMutations; ^2026.7.21 not yet on npm).

QUALITY GATE: npm run release:check PASSED.
- typecheck (tsc --noEmit): clean
- build (tsc): clean
- npm test: 61 tests pass / 0 fail (51 smoke + 10 new atomic)
- audit:prod: 0 vulnerabilities
- pack:dry-run: ok (9 files, 50.7 kB)
- changelog:check: up to date (no regeneration needed)

Atomic test coverage (test/atomic.test.ts, 10 tests):
1. mid-run failure -> reverse compensation restores created/updated/closed items (failed batch deletes every create; mixed batch restores updates+closes)
2. resume idempotence -> re-running same fetched set recovers SAME transaction, 0 duplicates
3. reordered-retry stability -> shuffled fetch order yields SAME transaction id & item ids
4. --atomic --dry-run -> shared prep path, correct counts (1 import/1 update/1 skip), NO SDK commit call
5. all-skipped non-dry atomic import -> throws legacy error shape (CommandError, 'Imported 0 issue(s); 1 failed'), before commit
6. transaction id changes when a mutation target changes (id, id_prefix, status)
Plus: incomplete compensation reported as partial+resumable; end-to-end update+close commit through the real SDK against a live tracker.
